basic_info.description: A rare opportunity in San Francisco's coveted stretch of Sunset, 396 Crestlake Drive captures the timeless character and quiet sophistication that defines Pine Lake Park. This single-level three-bedroom, two-bath home offers light-filled rooms, hardwood floors, and an intuitive floor plan that creates a natural flow between spaces. Expansive windows invite the outdoors in, framing peaceful views and bathing each room in a soft, welcoming glow. Surrounded by the best of the city's west side, Stern Grove, West Portal, and Lake Merced all just moments away. This residence delivers an effortless blend of classic charm, comfort, and city convenience. A refined retreat in a prized neighborhood.
